full_text_zh:
[P1] 散步遇到
小野花
撰文/潘美慧 插画/朱家钰
浙江出版联合集团

[P2] 散步遇到小野花
撰文/潘美慧 插画/朱家钰

浙江出版联合集团
浙江少年儿童出版社
2/11

[P3] 今天一大早，太阳刚出来的时候，朵朵和妈妈一起到河边去散步。她们看到了一大片黄色的小花，朵朵问：“这些花叫什么名字呢？为什么它们会被种在这里？”
兔儿菜
黄鹌菜
蒲公英
长柄菊

[P4] 黄色的
小野花
妈妈说，这些小野花是小动物和
风在去年种下的。今年春天，天气变暖
和了，雨水也充足了，小野花
就全都长出来，开花了。
长柄菊的花柄很长，可以把花举得
高高的，吸引昆虫来采蜜和传粉。
兔儿菜
黄鹌菜
蒲公英
长柄菊
兔儿菜的叶子狭长，像兔子的耳朵，
开黄色小花。它的小种子有冠毛，会
随着风飞走。
黄鹌菜的叶子有小锯齿，也开黄色
小花，花形比兔儿菜的小，种子也
有冠毛。
蒲公英的叶子成锯齿状，利用有冠毛
的种子传播，长出新的小苗。
蒲公英的地下根很长，冬天当叶子
干枯后，根会休眠，等春天到了再
长出新叶。
蛇莓
蛇莓开黄色小花，结红色小果。
它的果实是小动物喜爱的食物，种子不会被消化，当种子
被排出时，又可发芽生长。

[P5] 长成一大片的小野花
小野花虽然很小，但是小花开
成一大片，让人很容易看见它们。
妈妈对朵朵说：“你看，这片白色的小花多么漂亮
啊！它们吸引了好多昆虫来采蜜，让原本安静的野地，
一下子热闹了起来。”
白花藿香蓟（jì）
白花三叶草
大花咸丰草
唐松草
龙葵

[P6] 大花咸丰草
大花咸丰草由两种花组成：外围像花瓣的是舌状花，用来吸引昆虫的注意；中间黄色的是筒状花，这里才有雄蕊、雌蕊和花蜜。
白色的小野花
白色和黄色的小花非常受小昆虫喜爱。妈妈说：“小昆虫的眼睛和我们的不一样，我们眼睛看到的白色小花，在昆虫的眼里却不是白色的。”
龙葵
龙葵的花很小，而且是白色的，大型昆虫不容易看到它，要靠小型昆虫，如蚂蚁和小型的蜂类帮它传粉。
白花三叶草
白花三叶草的花由很多小花组成，白色的花束高举着，可吸引昆虫来拜访。白花三叶草有三片叶子，叶子上有白色的条纹。
人眼看到的白花
昆虫看到的白花
6/11

[P7] 花形花色多变的小野花
小野花不止有黄色和白色的，还有紫色和红色的，朵朵
见了，惊讶地说：“这些小花的颜色真漂亮，花的形状也很
好看呢！”
紫花藿香蓟
南国小蓟
紫花酢（cù）浆草
牵牛花
含羞草
通泉草
堇（jǐn）菜

[P8] 紫色和红色的小野花

紫色和红色的小野花颜色很漂亮，很容易吸引昆虫来采蜜。为了让昆虫看清楚花蜜在哪里，小野花上有许多蜜斑，能指引昆虫快速找到花蜜吃。

紫花藿香蓟和含羞草的花，都是管状花，花蕊伸出花瓣外，形成毛球状花形。

紫花藿香蓟

含羞草

堇菜、紫花酢浆草、通泉草的花朵中心都有蜜斑，可以帮助昆虫快速找到花蜜。

紫花酢浆草

通泉草

南国小蓟的叶面很小，叶裂尖端尖锐，用手触摸时会有刺痛的感觉。它的叶面角质化，不怕水分散失，可以生长在水分少、阳光强的地方。

南国小蓟

蜜斑

[P9] 小野花的大秘密
小野花的花朵虽然很小，甚至有些小野花是绿色的，很不起眼。不过，这些小野花却是许多昆虫和小动物重要的食物来源，它们都离不开这些小野花。
车前草
车前草的花很小，靠风来传播花粉。它的叶子是孔雀青蛱蝶幼虫喜爱的食物。
水蜈蚣
大飞扬草的叶子像一对对小翅膀，排列得很整齐。它的花很小，颜色是绿色的。
大飞扬草
full_text_en:
[P1] Taking a Walk and Meeting
Little Wildflowers
Written by Pan Meihui  Illustrated by Zhu Jiayu
Zhejiang Publishing United Group

[P2] A Walk with Little Wildflowers
Written by Pan Meihui  Illustrated by Zhu Jiayu

Zhejiang Publishing United Group
Zhejiang Children's Publishing House
2/11

[P3] Early in the morning, just as the sun was rising, Doudou and her mom went for a walk by the river. They saw a big patch of small yellow flowers. Doudou asked, "What are these flowers called? Why are they planted here?"
Rabbit's lettuce
Yellow rocket
Dandelion
Long-stemmed chrysanthemum

[P4] Yellow
Wildflowers
Mom says, these little wildflowers were planted last year by small animals and the wind. This spring, the weather warmed up, the rain was plentiful, and the wildflowers all grew and bloomed.
The stem of the long-stemmed chrysanthemum is very long, lifting the flower high to attract insects for nectar and pollination.
Rabbit lettuce
Yellow rape
Dandelion
Long-stemmed chrysanthemum
The leaves of rabbit lettuce are narrow and long, like a rabbit's ears, and it blooms with small yellow flowers. Its tiny seeds have pappus and can fly away with the wind.
The leaves of yellow rape have small serrations and also bloom with small yellow flowers. The flower shape is smaller than that of rabbit lettuce, and its seeds also have pappus.
The leaves of dandelion are serrated, and it uses seeds with pappus to spread, growing new seedlings.
The underground roots of dandelion are very long. In winter, when the leaves wither, the roots go dormant and grow new leaves again when spring arrives.
Snakeberry
Snakeberry blooms with small yellow flowers and bears red fruits.
Its fruits are loved by small animals as food. The seeds are not digested, and when they are excreted, they can germinate and grow again.

[P5] Growing in Big Patches of Wildflowers
Wildflowers may be small, but when they bloom in big patches, they are easy to see.
Mom said to Dodo, “Look, these white little flowers are so beautiful! They’ve attracted many insects to collect nectar, making the once-quiet meadow suddenly lively.”
White Flowered Chromolaena (jì)
White Flowered Clover
Large-flowered Xanthium
Meadow Rue
Black Nightshade

[P6] Large-flowered Bidens
Large-flowered Bidens consists of two types of flowers: the outer, petal-like ones are ray florets, which attract insects; the yellow center is the disc floret, where the stamens, pistils, and nectar are located.
White Wildflowers
White and yellow small flowers are very popular with small insects. Mom says: "Insects' eyes are different from ours. The white flowers we see are not white to insects."
Nightshade
Nightshade flowers are small and white. Large insects have difficulty seeing them, so they rely on small insects, such as ants and small bees, for pollination.
White Clover
White clover flowers are made up of many tiny flowers. The white flower clusters are held high to attract insects. White clover has three leaves, each with white stripes.
White flower as seen by human eyes
White flower as seen by insects
6/11

[P7] Wildflowers with Diverse Shapes and Colors
Wildflowers are not only yellow and white, but also purple and red. Dodo saw them and exclaimed, “These little flowers are so beautiful in color, and their shapes are lovely too!”
Purple Clusters of Agastache
Southern Thistle
Purple Oxalis (cù)
Morning Glory
Mimosa Pudica
Veronica
Viola (jǐn)

[P8] Purple and Red Wildflowers

Purple and red wildflowers are very beautiful and easily attract insects to collect nectar. To help insects see where the nectar is, these wildflowers have many nectar guides, which can lead insects quickly to the nectar.

The flowers of purple mistflower and sensitive plant are both tubular flowers, with stamens extending beyond the petals, forming a fuzzy ball-shaped bloom.

Purple Mistflower

Sensitive Plant

Violets, purple oxalis, and creeping primrose all have nectar guides at the center of their flowers, which help insects find the nectar quickly.

Purple Oxalis

Creeping Primrose

The leaves of South China thistle are small, with sharp, pointed leaf lobes. Touching them will cause a stinging sensation. Its leaves are waxy, preventing water loss, allowing it to grow in dry, sunny places.

South China Thistle

Nectar Guide

[P9] The Big Secret of Wildflowers
Although the flowers of wildflowers are small, and some are even green and inconspicuous, these little wildflowers are an important food source for many insects and small animals. They all depend on these wildflowers.
Plantain
The flowers of plantain are very small and rely on wind to spread pollen. Its leaves are a favorite food of the peacock blue butterfly caterpillar.
Water Centipede
The leaves of the large creeping oxalis look like pairs of little wings, arranged very neatly. Its flowers are very small and green.
Large Creeping Oxalis
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本的封面，标题为《散步遇到小野花》，画面中一位母亲和女儿在草地上散步，小女孩蹲下观察野花，旁边有一只小狗在奔跑，背景是蓝天和花草，充满童趣与自然气息。
[P2] 本页为绘本的标题页，显示书名《散步遇到小野花》及作者、插画师信息，下方有一只蝴蝶插图，底部标注出版社和页码。
[P3] 朵朵和妈妈在河边散步时，看到一大片黄色小花，朵朵好奇地询问花的名字和种植原因，画面中还标注了兔儿菜、黄鹌菜、蒲公英和长柄菊等植物名称。
[P4] 本页介绍了多种黄色小野花，包括兔儿菜、黄鹌菜、蒲公英、长柄菊和蛇莓，通过图文并茂的方式说明了它们的外形特征、生长习性和传播方式，并配以小女孩观察蒲公英种子飘散和小鸟吃蛇莓果实的插图。
[P5] 朵朵和妈妈在草地上散步，看到一大片白色小野花，妈妈向朵朵解释这些花吸引了许多昆虫，使野地变得热闹。画面中还标注了白花藿香蓟、白花三叶草、大花咸丰草、唐松草和龙葵等植物。
[P6] 本页介绍了几种白色小野花，包括大花咸丰草、龙葵和白花三叶草，说明了它们的形态特征和吸引昆虫的方式，并通过插图解释了昆虫眼中白色花朵与人类所见的不同。
[P7] 朵朵和妈妈在草地上发现紫色和红色的小野花，朵朵惊叹于它们的美丽与多样性，页面展示了紫花藿香蓟、南国小蓟、紫花酢浆草、牵牛花、含羞草、通泉草和堇菜等植物。
[P8] 本页介绍了紫色和红色的小野花，说明它们通过鲜艳的颜色和花心的蜜斑吸引昆虫采蜜，并展示了紫花藿香蓟、含羞草、堇菜、紫花酢浆草、通泉草和南国小蓟等植物的特征与生长习性。
[P9] 本页介绍了小野花对昆虫和小动物的重要性，并重点描述了车前草和大飞扬草的形态特征及生态作用，配以插图展示它们在草地上的生长情景。
[P10] 画面描绘了朵朵和妈妈手牵手在草地上散步，旁边有蝴蝶在花丛中飞舞，远处是大海，展现了自然和谐的景象。
